steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Configure an RFQ pricing stage for the vendor bid.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product for the bid sheet.
Populate the pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite one vendor who will submit the bid.
Publish the event so the vendor can access its bid sheet.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Act as the invited vendor, press Submit, and submit the bid with a concrete value.
Assert the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted with its values.
Assert the buyer sees exactly one direct vendor response and the buyer-side participation count has increased.
